classification.reason: Request is a scientific goal or asks for planning without a concrete workflow.

plan.goal: Retrieve UniProt sequences annotated with NAD(P)HX epimerase activity (GO:0097630) and ADP-dependent NAD(P)H-hydrate dehydratase activity (GO:0097631), characterize biochemical properties and identify representative sequences for each enzymatic family via sequence_analysis, generate ESM3 structure and embedding predictions for those representatives, and rank all candidates by integrated metrics using rank_designs.
assumptions: GO:0097630 is the canonical GO term for NAD(P)H-hydrate epimerase (NADPHX epimerase) activity; GO:0097631 is the canonical term for ADP-dependent NAD(P)H-hydrate dehydratase activity — the two enzymatic pillars of the NAD(P)HX repair system.

UniProt annotation coverage for these specialized metabolite-repair GO terms is limited; max_sequences:50 per term is sufficient to capture the full annotated set across both reviewed and unreviewed entries.
No taxon_id restriction is applied to maximize phylogenetic diversity across both enzymatic families.
sequence_analysis representative_sequences items expose a 'sequence' string field accessible as ${item.sequence} in ESM3 foreach fan-out nodes.
ESM3 runs only on representative sequences (typically 5–15 per GO group from sequence_analysis), keeping compute tractable; confidence_scores and embeddings inform the final ranking.
rank_designs uses default aggregation weights since no user-specified scoring criteria were provided.
Literature search runs in parallel with sequence retrieval and provides mechanistic context for result interpretation; it does not gate any downstream node.

success_criteria.go_epimerase: Non-empty FASTA returned for GO:0097630 NAD(P)HX epimerase annotated UniProt entries
success_criteria.go_dehydratase: Non-empty FASTA returned for GO:0097631 ADP-dependent dehydratase annotated UniProt entries
success_criteria.lit_context: At least 5 publications retrieved covering NAD(P)HX repair, NAXE, NAXD, or metabolite-damage mechanisms
success_criteria.analysis_epimerase: Composition metrics, motifs, liabilities, and representative_sequences produced for the epimerase family
success_criteria.analysis_dehydratase: Composition metrics, motifs, liabilities, and representative_sequences produced for the dehydratase family
success_criteria.esm3_epimerase: Per-residue embeddings and confidence_scores produced for each epimerase representative sequence
success_criteria.esm3_dehydratase: Per-residue embeddings and confidence_scores produced for each dehydratase representative sequence
success_criteria.ranking: Ranked list of up to 20 representative candidates integrating sequence analysis annotations and ESM3 predictions across both enzymatic families; ranked_candidates and ranked_tsv artifacts available

inputs.query: NAD(P)HX repair epimerase dehydratase NAXE NAXD metabolite damage
